items.method: Direct polar source and positive factored denominator at every formal order.
Independent rational Laurent Fourier differentiation, inverse and transport products.
Written minimization at balanced interaction orders; individual coefficients were not assumed negative.
Sign induction from the explicit recurrence; 48 finite sample hierarchies through order8 support the proof.
The two-term actual expansion does not supply the required all-order hierarchy; multipoles and logarithms remain to be controlled.
